title: AI Outfit Assistant
description: Query real items or preview up to 3 everyday, commute or formal outfits using recorded colors, types and formality.
inputLabel: What would you like to wear or find?
placeholder: Supported Chinese: 帮我搭配一套日常穿搭 / 帮我搭配三套通勤穿搭，包含白色衬衫和蓝色牛仔裤 / 推荐正式穿搭
inputHelp: You can edit your request while it runs; this cancels the previous preview.
loading: Querying your wardrobe and preparing a preview…
previewOnly: Individual item previews only. These results are not a complete outfit, and no outfit has been saved.
emptyState: Describe your wardrobe request to get started.

guidance.needs_clarification: Answer the assistant’s question with more detail, such as the item types you want to find.
guidance.no_items: No available items were found. Check the matching wardrobe items and their status.
guidance.invalid_result: This preview could not be validated. Please generate it again.

errors.auth: Sign in again to use the assistant.
errors.invalidInput: The request was not accepted. Check your input and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
errors.failed: The preview request failed. Please try again.
errors.invalidResponse: The service returned an unexpected response. Please try again.

runtimeNotice.unknown: Read-only wardrobe query previews. The backend has not confirmed the model mode. Previewing does not save an outfit.
runtimeNotice.configured: The backend confirmed local Ollama qwen3:0.6b-cpu configuration; this check does not run inference. Supports wardrobe queries and up to 3 basic everyday or commute outfits, verified by the backend. Previews are not saved. Use the supported Chinese examples.
runtimeNotice.unavailable: The backend reports that the local model is unavailable or its CPU configuration is unconfirmed. This status check does not run the model. Previews remain read-only.
runtimeNotice.remoteConfigured: The remote model endpoint is reachable. This check ran no inference and does not verify GPU execution. Previews are not saved.
runtimeNotice.remoteUnavailable: The SSH tunnel endpoint or remote model service is unavailable. Check the manually established tunnel and service. No automatic fallback to the local model.

outfitPreviewOnly: Unsaved basic outfit preview. Check suitability for your setting; weather and materials are not inferred.

runtimeDetails.label: Inference runtime status
runtimeDetails.gpuUnverified: GPU execution has not been verified; GPU acceleration is not confirmed.
runtimeDetails.gpuReadinessOnly: Service readiness only. GPU execution evidence is shown with each request result.

tunnelState.disconnected: SSH tunnel endpoint disconnected or model service unavailable

requestExecution.label: Request execution
requestExecution.gpuVerified: This request was verified on the approved remote GPU.
requestExecution.gpuUnverified: No trusted GPU execution evidence is available for this request.
requestExecution.copyFallback: Some text uses a safe backend fallback.
requestExecution.proofExpired: Evidence is expired or not currently verifiable. These are historical samples.
requestExecution.sampleScope: Samples cover the captured window, not a guaranteed whole-request peak.
